title: Citus: process-kill chaos + Patroni rejoin
description: Runs `nexus chaos citus process-kill`: SIGSTOPs nexus-patroni on a worker-group replica via the embedded nexus-chaos.sh (the group stays writable on its leader), captures impact, lifts, restarts the member, and confirms recovery to green.

observe.what: froze a worker-group replica nexus-patroni, captured impact, lifted + restarted -> all probes green
froze the coordinator replica; the coordinator group stayed writable on its leader; recovered green

whatProves: CitusAdapter.ApplyChaosAsync SIGSTOPs a single nexus-patroni unit (a worker-group replica by default), then lifts + restarts it and confirms the cluster recovers to green — Patroni HA absorbing a member loss.
